# GenVidVerbs89

Named action/condition handler over GeneralVideoConfigC89. It can be attached to any engine or DSL registry.

Actions: video_resolution, video_output_size, screen_scale, video_vsync, video_filter, video_keep_aspect, video_center_output, video_apply.

Conditions: video_integer_scale, video_letterboxed, video_is_native, video_is_stretched, video_is_overscan, video_vsync_enabled, video_filter_nearest, video_filter_linear.

Protocol89: ISO C89, no heap, no float/double, no explicit 64-bit types.
